description: Start an N-of-1 experiment for the signed-in user. `answers` maps baseline question ids (from supstack_experiment_protocol) to the user's answers. If required baseline answers are missing, returns a 400 listing them — gather those and retry. If an earlier experiment with this supplement ended while paused for safety, returns a 409 `prior_safety_pause` with `restartRequires`: relay its message, ask the user in their own words for the restart record (reviewerRole, reviewedOn YYYY-MM-DD, dose, productForm, restartPlan, clinicianAdvisedRestart true only if a clinician ADVISED it, seriousInjury, seriousIllness, eventResolution, illnessAssessmentComplete, otherExposures, and clearanceReference for documented-clearance) and retry with `restartRecord`. On a successful start, when `safety` is set, relay each of `safety.risks` word for word, and when `safety.uncheckedAxes` is set, say those were not checked: an `unavailable` level means the experiment was not safety-screened at all. Pharmacist ruling 354 (option 3): only seriousInjury "excluded" (the clinician explicitly ruled out a serious reaction to this product) may go on to the other restart checks. confirmed, suspected-or-unresolved, not-discussed, missing or unknown are held whatever clearance is recorded, refused with 409 product_reaction_held: relay its message first, and never invite the user to change a real event into a mistake. A clearance reference never means the clinician ruled it out. Ruling 355: seriousIllness not-discussed is held until the clinician assesses it. confirmed needs eventResolution resolved or stable as the clinician assessed it, plus clearanceReference (documented advice for this exact product). suspected-or-unresolved needs all of that and illnessAssessmentComplete true, only if the user says the clinician completed a safety assessment and documented that this exact product may be restarted despite the uncertain diagnosis.  Never fill it in for them. Owner call O-5: a 409 `population_blocked` means the user's health profile (with the baseline allergy history for bee pollen and royal jelly) blocks this product, for every product: nothing was created. Relay its `message`, then `footer` and `eligibility`, word for word. A 409 `start_in_progress` means a start of this product is already in progress or awaiting completion: nothing was created, relay its `message` word for word and do not start another. A 500 with `started: false` (and `experimentId` when a record was created) carries a `message` that says what is and is not confirmed saved: relay it word for word and do not retry the start. Returns the created experiment with its first check-in date. A refusal that carries `eligibility` (the pharmacist's complete rule: the pre-start form on a start, the restart form on a restart) must be shown to the user word for word, after the refusal's `message`. Never summarise it. A refusal with `app_restart_unavailable` or `permanently_excluded` is not released by any record: relay its `message` word for word. Requires the user to be signed in (`supstack login`).
name: supstack_experiment_start
